names.ja: ブループロフェッショナル

intro.zh: 暖纸色背景配钴蓝强调色，现代无衬线字体，克制专业；适合咨询汇报、经营复盘和投资者沟通。
intro.en: Warm paper background with cobalt-blue accents and a modern sans; quiet and professional, for consulting readouts, business reviews and investor updates.
intro.ja: 温かい紙色の背景にコバルトブルーのアクセント、モダンなサンセリフ。コンサル報告や経営レビュー向け。

routing.avoid: Playful, image-led or highly expressive creative material.

pageMapping.differences: Source is a paper page with a pale grey slanted panel on the right, a short blue dash above the title and a dot grid; native draws a solid cobalt panel on the left with a white cross mark and puts the title to its right.

Source is a 2 x 3 grid of ruled rows with blue numerals 01-06, a small-caps eyebrow and a pill tag; native is one row of four outlined rounded boxes joined by arrows, with a cobalt edge stripe and no numerals, eyebrow or tag.

Source puts each figure in a filled grey rounded card with three supporting lines and a green/red change line; native figures are open with only a bottom rule, a label and one note, with no change indicator, eyebrow or pill tag.
Source is a 2 x 3 dashboard of six small filled figure cards with an inline unit after each value; native is one row of three open figures over a bottom rule.

Source splits the page: five numbered points on the left, and on the right a quote box with a blue left bar, three small figure tiles and a footnote; native is a single bulleted column without numerals, quote box or figure tiles.
Source is seven horizontal ranked bars drawn as rounded blue fills on grey tracks with a percentage at the right end; native is an editable vertical column chart with axes and a legend, no tracks.
Source centres the quote on a full paper page with a large pale quote glyph and two circle ornaments; native puts the quote left-aligned beside a solid cobalt panel, with no glyph or ornaments.
Source is four numbered blue circles (fading in strength) joined by short dashes with centred captions; native is a continuous line with unnumbered dots and a period label above each dot.
Source is a 2 x 3 grid of six filled grey rounded cards each holding three bullets; native is one row of three open blocks with a cobalt leading rule and a single body line.
Source is centred on the paper page inside a faint circle with a blue pill button; native reuses the cover layout: solid cobalt panel on the left, left-aligned title, no circle and no button.
